An '''air cooler''' was a type of cooling device used at [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] during the [[Battle of Drongar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="MBS" /> At some point during [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> an air cooler in [[Jos Vondar]]'s surgery area was malfunctioning.<ref name="MBS" />
